title: Live no-new-information baseline comparison
goal: Show that the exact prior and current portable baseline are unchanged and justify a bounded stop.

observations.claim: The exact prior and current portable baseline capsule are unchanged.
observations.pass_condition: Deterministic capsule comparison returns NO_NEW_INFORMATION with matching exact references.
observations.route_guidance: Run known inputs and assert the exact outputs.
observations.observed_evidence: The stored comparison receipt returns NO_NEW_INFORMATION, refreshRequired false, and automaticAction false.
observations.counterevidence: A content, configuration, subject, information-reference, or freshness difference would refute the claim.

limitations: This proves only the previously scoped portable-baseline-capsule leaf is unchanged; it does not claim the whole shared Workshop is unchanged.
